Description: Infectious people recover and become immune.

Name: R0
Description: The basic reproduction number, defined as the number of individuals that an infected individual can infect when introduced into a completely susceptible population.

Name: RE
Description: The effective reproduction number, defined as the number of individuals infected by a typical infectious individual when a fraction of the population is protected from infection.

Name: δ
Description: The removal rate of bacteria from water.

Name: 1/δ
Description: Cholera life span in water reservoir.

Name: ξ
Description: Rate of water contamination by humans, i.e. rate of increase in V. cholerae concentration in the water reservoir.

Name: κ
Description: Concentration of cholera that yields 50% chance of infection.
